description: List the webhooks in a single channel or across a whole server (id, name, channel, token when visible, creator). Provide channel_id or guild_id; when both are given, only channel_id is used. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission. SECURITY: a returned token lets anyone post as that webhook; treat it as a secret. Pass the id and token to discord_send_webhook_message, or create a webhook with discord_create_webhook.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of a channel to list webhooks for. Takes precedence over guild_id.

guild_id.description: Discord server (guild) ID (snowflake) to list all webhooks for. Ignored when channel_id is given.

name: discord_list_webhooks
